Method of Attack: Ransomware attack involving unauthorized access to networks, data exfiltration, and extortion via personalized threats to patients
Data extortion with threats to leak stolen data on dark web extortion portal
Emailing patients individually with personal data to coerce payment
Impacted Systems: clinical network of Fred Hutchinson Cancer Center
Indicators of Compromise: 533.1GB of data allegedly stolen and listed on Hunters International extortion portal
Emails sent to over 800,000 patients containing personal information including names, Social Security numbers, phone numbers, medical history, lab results, insurance history
Threat emails containing patient address, phone number, medical record number, and payment link
